scenarios.title: The Toxic Donkey
scenarios.hook: Beware of Wren, the toxic donkey! He's in the garden eating the entire harvest! Stop him or we'll starve!

scenarios.title: Troll Trouble
scenarios.hook: A group of trolls has appeared in the Wilderness! Confront them with your wits or swords before they steal all the supplies!

scenarios.title: The Missing Merchant
scenarios.hook: Old Willem the merchant never arrived from the mountain pass. His cart was found abandoned, tracks leading into the dark forest...

scenarios.title: Wolf Pack
scenarios.hook: A pack of wolves has been spotted near the village! The livestock are in danger - brave souls are needed to drive them off!

scenarios.title: The Cursed Well
scenarios.hook: The village well has turned black and foul. Strange whispers echo from its depths at night. Someone must investigate!

scenarios.title: Goblin Raiders
scenarios.hook: Goblins have been raiding farms on the outskirts! Track them to their hideout and put an end to their mischief!

scenarios.title: The Wandering Spirit
scenarios.hook: A ghostly figure has been seen on the old road at midnight. The spirit seems distressed - perhaps it needs help moving on?

scenarios.title: Festival Sabotage
scenarios.hook: Someone is sabotaging the harvest festival preparations! Decorations destroyed, food spoiled. Find the culprit before the celebration is ruined!

scenarios.title: The Cattle Rustlers
scenarios.hook: Cattle have gone missing from the Johnson ranch three nights running. Fresh tracks head toward Dead Man's Gulch...

scenarios.title: Snake Oil Scandal
scenarios.hook: A traveling salesman's 'miracle tonic' has made half the town sick! He's trying to skip town - someone stop that wagon!

scenarios.title: Train Robbery
scenarios.hook: The 3:10 from Yuma was held up! The bandits took the payroll and are holed up somewhere in the canyon. There's a bounty for their capture!

scenarios.title: The Haunted Mine
scenarios.hook: Strange lights and sounds from the old Copper King mine. Miners refuse to work. Is it ghosts, or something more earthly?

scenarios.title: Showdown at Noon
scenarios.hook: Black Bart McGraw has called out the Sheriff for a duel at high noon. The Sheriff's arm is injured - he needs backup!

scenarios.title: The Water War
scenarios.hook: Someone's been damming up the creek, leaving downstream ranches dry. Tensions are rising - find out who and why before guns are drawn!

scenarios.title: Runaway Stagecoach
scenarios.hook: The stagecoach horses spooked and bolted! The driver's been thrown and passengers are trapped inside as it careens toward the cliff!

scenarios.title: The Card Cheat
scenarios.hook: Someone at the saloon poker game is cheating, and accusations are flying. A fight's about to break out unless someone can prove who the real cheat is!

scenarios.title: Distress Signal
scenarios.hook: A distress beacon from an unregistered vessel. Could be survivors, could be pirates. Either way, someone should check it out...

scenarios.title: System Breach
scenarios.hook: Unknown code is propagating through the ship's systems. Life support fluctuating. Find the source before we're all breathing vacuum!

scenarios.title: Cargo Gone Wrong
scenarios.hook: Something in cargo bay 3 is making noise. The manifest says 'agricultural equipment' but that doesn't sound like any tractor I've ever heard...

scenarios.title: The Stowaway
scenarios.hook: Food stores are depleting faster than they should. Someone - or something - is hiding aboard. Find them before supplies run critical!

scenarios.title: Pirate Ambush
scenarios.hook: Raiders dropping out of hyperspace! They're demanding we surrender our cargo. We can fight, flee, or negotiate - but we need to act fast!

scenarios.title: The AI's Request
scenarios.hook: The station AI is acting strange, asking crew members cryptic questions. It claims to have 'discovered something important' but won't say what...

scenarios.title: Derelict Discovery
scenarios.hook: Long-range sensors picked up a drifting ship. No life signs, but the reactor's still warm. Salvage rights to whoever investigates!

scenarios.title: Alien Artifact
scenarios.hook: The artifact we recovered is emitting strange readings. Crew members near it report vivid dreams. Is it valuable tech or dangerous cargo?

scenarios.title: The Lost Kitten
scenarios.hook: A tiny kitten has been spotted wandering the neighborhood, looking scared and hungry. Can someone help find where it belongs?

scenarios.title: Garden Party Preparations
scenarios.hook: The community garden party is tomorrow and there's so much to do! Decorations, food, music - many hands make light work!

scenarios.title: The Baking Disaster
scenarios.hook: Someone's attempt at baking has gone hilariously wrong. The kitchen needs rescuing, and maybe we can salvage something edible?

scenarios.title: Stargazing Night
scenarios.hook: Clear skies tonight! Perfect for setting up blankets and hot cocoa. Who wants to watch for shooting stars together?
